id: 743-賈索·錢·卡維爾一世征服瓦卡

battle.name: 賈索·錢·卡維爾一世征服瓦卡
battle.brief: 743年，法蘭克公爵賈索·錢·卡維爾一世率軍東進，圍攻圖林根叛首瓦卡據守的奧爾拉河畔布克蘭堡；破堡後瓦卡逃往斯拉夫人地界被殺。卡面的埃及月牙劍是彎刃單邊砍劈器的源流，它不可能出現在743年的戰場，但同一技術路線的薩克森式彎刃短刀正是當地步兵的日常兵器，與法蘭克投石斧同場相對。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 這場戰爭發生於743年，戰場在中歐的圖林根（Thuringia）奧爾拉河（Orla）谷地。交戰一方是法蘭克王國：國家的名義首腦是自751年即位的丕平三世（Pepin III），實權卻分散在兩位宮相（mayor of the palace）手中，東境與西境的軍政大權分別由長子卡洛曼與幼子賈索·錢·卡維爾一世分掌；奧爾拉河谷名義上位於卡洛曼治理的奧斯特拉西亞邊界，但遠征由查理曼以法蘭克公爵（dux Francorum）的身分領軍，憑藉王室的授權與宮相的徵召權取得整個體系的支持。軍隊是典型的早期中世紀徵召聯軍：核心為受封的貴族與軍士階層的披甲騎兵，配以各地按份額提供的步兵，步軍以圓盾、長矛與投石斧為主，另有弓手以及隨軍的築壘工匠；東境線上的奧布格納希特（Obodrite）聯盟一向是法蘭克的外交盟友，但這次遠征的具體兵員編組沒有留下名冊。另一方是拒絕效忠丕平三世的圖林根叛軍：首領瓦卡（Wacco）被自己的氏族推舉為公爵，佔據奧爾拉河畔的木寨布克蘭堡（Buclanburg）作為核心據點，守軍為圖林根與薩克森系的戰士，配備長矛、投石與彎刃短刀，並且同易北河下游的斯拉夫與波美拉尼亞一帶保持往來。這場衝突的勝負不由雙方正面會戰決定，而由攻城能力與補給控制決定。
countriesEn: This war was fought in 743, on the Orla valley in Thuringia in central Europe. One side was the Frankish kingdom: its nominal head was Pepin III, who had reigned since 751, but real power was divided between two mayors of the palace, with the military and administrative command of the eastern and western realms held respectively by the elder son Carloman and the younger son Charles the Great. The Orla valley formally lay on the border of Carloman's Austrasia, yet the expedition was led by Charlemagne in the capacity of duke of the Franks, drawing on the royal mandate and on the recruiting authority of the mayor of the palace. The army was a typical early medieval levy: a core of armoured mounted nobles and military retainers, supplemented by infantry contributed by each district, the foot soldiers carrying round shields, spears and throwing axes, together with archers and the engineers who built the field fortifications. The Obodrite alliance along the eastern frontier had long been a diplomatic partner of the Franks, but no roster of the actual contingents fielded in this campaign survives. The other side was the Thuringian insurgents who refused to acknowledge Pepin III's overlordship: their leader Wacco was raised as duke by his own kindred and occupied the timber stockade of Buclanburg on the Orla as his central stronghold. Its garrison consisted of Thuringian and Saxon warriors equipped with spears, slings and curved single-edged knives, and it maintained contacts with the Slavs and Pomerania below the Elbe. The issue of this conflict was never to be settled in an open field battle, but by siegecraft and the control of supplies.
people: 賈索·錢·卡維爾一世，即查理曼（Charlemagne，約742年生，814年卒），是這場戰爭的指揮者。743年時他約三十歲，兩年前已取得宮相之職，父王丕平三世尚在世，他仍以公爵身分統兵；同年4月6日他主持了阿蒂尼的教務會議，會後不久即出兵東進。瓦卡（Wacco，又作 Waco、Wakko）是圖林根叛軍的首領，也是這場戰爭的另一主角：艾因哈德記他據守奧爾拉河畔的布克蘭堡，破堡後逃往斯拉夫人地界，最後被一個名叫瓦內茨（Wanez）的人殺死；瓦內茨的出身與所屬派系，史料並沒有交代清楚。合法公爵維林赫爾（Werinher）在事發之前已被自己人驅逐，戰後他被查理曼重新確認為部分圖林根地區的公爵，並參與當時對圖林根的重新分區。教會方面，聖高樂（Goar）的傳記把高樂在查理曼麾下任職、參與東方遠征的經歷同743年的阿蒂尼會議連在一起，聖溫弗拉（Winfrid of Kilmartin）的傳記也說他以近侍身分在軍中效力；這些都是為宣揚殉道與聖德而寫的生平，往往帶有後世加工的痕跡，應與艾因哈德的敘述對讀。此外，後來為瓦卡加上殉道者身分的圖林根地方傳說，多數出自11至12世紀的編年史與地方聖徒傳，才把743年的遠征塑造成圖林根民族抵抗的起點。
peopleEn: Charles the Great, that is Charlemagne (born about 742, died 814), commanded this war. In 743 he was about thirty years old and had held the office of mayor of the palace for two years; his father Pepin III was still alive, and he led the host in the capacity of duke. On 6 April of the same year he presided over the ecclesiastical council at Attigny, and it was not long afterwards that he marched east. Wacco (also written Waco, Wakko) was the head of the Thuringian insurgents and the other principal figure of the war: Einhard records that he held Buclanburg on the Orla, and after the fortress fell he fled towards Slav territory and was finally killed by a man named Wanez; the origin and faction of Wanez are not explained by the sources. The legitimate duke Werinher had already been driven out by his own people before the crisis, and afterwards Charlemagne confirmed him again as duke of part of Thuringia and had him share in the redivision of the region. On the ecclesiastical side, the Vita of Saint Goar links Goar's service under Charlemagne and his participation in an eastern expedition with the council of Attigny in 743, while the Vita of Saint Winfrid of Kilmartin says that he served in the army as a court attendant. Both are Lives written to promote a saint's cult and sanctity, and both bear the marks of later reworking; they should be read against Einhard's narrative. Moreover, the Thuringian local tradition that later made Wacco into a martyr comes chiefly from eleventh- and twelfth-century chronicles and local saints' Lives, which are what turned the campaign of 743 into the opening page of a Thuringian national resistance.
kits: 卡面上的兵器是埃及月牙劍（Khopesh）：青銅時代近東的外彎單刃砍劈器，寬闊的刃身帶著內彎的尖端，握柄下端常有配重，以便在近身格鬥中以拉、扭的方式把刃從目標的護具或骨肉上拔出。這種兵器在743年的圖林根根本不可能出現，它屬於青銅時代的技術譜系，比本戰早了一千兩百多年；卡面在此扮演的角色，是把「彎刃砍擊、不必拔出」這個技術母題標示出來。真正在奧爾拉河畔相對的是兩套北方裝備：其一是薩克森—圖林根式的彎刃單邊短刀（seax，薩克森短刀），它與月牙劍共享同一條設計邏輯，重心靠近刃尖，能把劈砍的動能集中在極短的距離內；其二是法蘭克重步兵的直刃長劍（spatha）與投石斧（francisca），考古出土的薩爾布呂肯與科隆一帶法蘭克墳葬中的投石斧，連柄長約五十公分、重量約一公斤上下，斧刃寬約十公分，弧刃外傾，專為飛擲後砍入人體而設計。此外還有長矛、圓盾（直徑約六十公分）、鼻盔、環形鎖甲與護腕，騎兵另有馬鎧與馬槍。攻城方面則是壕溝、土壘、柴柵、木塔與雲梯，工兵填平外壕並在牆下掘進；畜力運輸靠牛拉的木製車隊，戰馬與役畜的飼料則從後方徵收。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Egyptian khopesh: a bronze-age, near-eastern curved single-edged chopping sword, its broad blade drawn back into an inward-curving point, with a counterweight at the pommel so that the blade can be pulled or twisted free of armour and flesh in close fighting. Such a weapon could not possibly have been present in Thuringia in 743; it belongs to a bronze-age technical lineage more than twelve centuries older than this war, and the role of the card here is to mark out the technical motif of the curved chopping blade that needs no pulling back. What actually faced each other in the Orla valley were two northern equipment systems. The first was the Saxon-Thuringian curved single-edged knife, the seax, which shares the same design logic as the khopesh: its point of balance lies close to the tip, so that the energy of the blow is concentrated over a very short distance. The second was the straight-edged spatha and the throwing axe of the Frankish heavy infantry; Frankish throwing axes recovered from aristocratic burials around Weissenburg and Cologne measure roughly half a metre including the haft, weigh about a kilogram, and carry a broad, outward-curving blade about ten centimetres across, designed to be thrown and then driven into a body. There were also spears, round shields about sixty centimetres in diameter, nasal helmets, ring mail and bracers, while the cavalry had mail for the horse and the lance. For the siege the Frankish side used ditches, earthen ramparts, palisades, timber towers and scaling ladders, with engineers filling in the outer ditch and digging under the walls; draught transport was by ox-drawn wooden wagons, and feed for the warhorses and draught animals was levied from the rear.
tactics: 743年的圖林根遠征是一場以圍城和掃蕩為主、幾乎沒有正面會戰的戰役。遠征軍沿貫穿中部德意志的軍用道路東行，自溫爾斯（Worms）一帶的宮殿出發，經法蘭克福與艾爾福特方向，穿越倫山（Rhön）南麓的高地，最後沿奧爾拉河谷南下；這條路線全程約三四百公里，補給完全依靠沿途徵收的糧食與徵用的牛車，沒有一條可以脫離村鎮的後方補給線。進入圖林根之後，軍隊沒有先去攻打散在各地的村落，而是直撲瓦卡的中樞堡壘：步兵在堡外挖環形壕溝，築起土壘與木柵，架設木塔封住牆頭的射界，騎兵則被派出去巡邏奧爾拉河兩岸與周邊山道，切斷各個圖林根部落匯入堡壘的道路與消息，同時攔截可能由斯拉夫方向趕來的援軍。圍城是一種消耗：守軍糧食見底、紀律鬆散之後，遠征軍才發動強攻，或以撞擊與填壕的工程手段打開缺口。破堡之後，遠征軍不再停留在堡區，而是以小分隊騎兵為主，一邊搜捕逃亡者，一邊系統地燒毀田莊與穀倉，把方圓數十里的居民往南方的法蘭克核心區驅趕；瓦卡本人則在通往斯拉夫地界的路上被追殺。整個作戰的技術核心，是「以快速騎兵巡邏切斷敵方集結、以圍城拖垮守軍、以有計畫的破壞消滅再叛能力」這套在後來的薩克森戰爭中被反覆使用的模式。
tacticsEn: The Thuringian campaign of 743 was a war of siege and devastation with almost no set-piece battle. The host moved east along the military roads that crossed central Germany, setting out from the palace at Worms, passing by Frankfurt and in the direction of Erfurt, crossing the uplands south of the Rhön mountains and finally descending into the Orla valley. The whole route ran some three or four hundred kilometres, and supply depended entirely on grain levied in the villages along the way and on ox-carts requisitioned from them: there was no line of communications that could be separated from the settled country behind the army. Once in Thuringia, the army did not begin by destroying the scattered villages, but struck straight at the heart of Wacco's power, the fortress. The infantry dug a ring ditch around it, raised earthen ramparts and timber palisades, and mounted wooden towers that closed the line of sight along the walls, while cavalry were sent out to patrol both banks of the Orla and the tracks over the hills, cutting the roads and the messages by which the separate Thuringian kindreds could join the garrison, and intercepting any relief that might come from the Slav direction. The siege was an affair of attrition: only after the defenders' grain ran short and their discipline loosened did the besiegers launch an assault, or open a breach by ramming and by filling the ditch. Once the fortress had fallen the army no longer sat on the stronghold, but worked in small mounted detachments, hunting fugitives while systematically burning farmsteads and granaries and driving the population of the surrounding countryside south towards the Frankish heartland; Wacco himself was run down and killed on the road towards the Slav frontier. The technical core of the whole operation was a combination later repeated in the Saxon wars: fast cavalry patrols to sever the enemy's concentration, siege to exhaust the garrison, and deliberate destruction to remove the capacity for renewed revolt.
data: 關於這場戰爭，可核對的數字極少。年份是743年，這是唯一沒有爭議的數據；月份在原始記載中沒有留下，743年4月6日阿蒂尼教務會議的特許狀是本戰最近的同期文件，一般把遠征視為同年春夏之交，卡面按743年6月登錄，屬於推定。地理上，奧爾拉河是圖林根北境的一條小河，全長約九十公里，自東向西匯入薩勒河，瓦卡據守的布克蘭堡位於河谷之中，但具體坐標無法確定，學界只把它大略放在阿波爾達（Apolda）至奧爾拉蒙德（Orlamünde）一帶的河谷地形中；考慮到名字的相近，也有意見認為它就是布克蘭附近的同名村寨。兵員方面沒有留下任何名冊：743年的遠征規模無法確知，同時期法蘭克在東方的大規模行動，估計在數千人到一萬餘人之間，但這樣的數字只能當作量級的參考。距離方面，溫爾斯宮殿到奧爾拉河谷的行程約三四百公里，中途要翻越倫山南麓的高地；艾因哈德另有一個常被引用的細節：遠征回程時查理曼在布魯赫豪森（Bruchhusi）村發起熱病，由隨軍士兵抬著走了三天才回到溫爾斯宮殿。傷亡數字同樣空白：圍城中的守軍損失、追擊中的死亡人數都沒有記載，只留下瓦卡一人被殺的紀錄。
dataEn: Very little about this war can be checked against numbers. The year, 743, is the only datum beyond dispute; the month does not survive in the original account, and the charter of the council of Attigny dated 6 April 743 is the nearest contemporary document to the campaign, so the expedition is generally placed in the late spring or summer of that year, and the card records June on that basis as an inference. Geographically, the Orla is a small river on the northern edge of Thuringia, some ninety kilometres long, flowing westwards into the Saale, and the fortress of Buclanburg that Wacco held lay somewhere in its valley, but its exact position cannot be established; scholarship places it roughly in the valley terrain between Apolda and Orlamünde, and, taking the similarity of the name, some opinions hold that it was the village of the same name near Buchland. There is no roll of any kind for the troops: the size of the expedition in 743 is simply unknown, and although comparable Frankish campaigns in the east are estimated at anywhere from several thousand men to more than ten thousand, such figures can only serve as an order of magnitude. As for distance, the journey from the palace at Worms to the Orla valley ran some three or four hundred kilometres, over the uplands south of the Rhön. Einhard supplies one further detail that is often quoted: on the return from the campaign Charlemagne fell ill with a fever at the village of Bruchhusi and had to be carried by his men for three days before reaching the palace at Worms. Casualty figures are equally blank: the losses of the garrison during the siege and the deaths in the pursuit are not recorded, and only the killing of Wacco himself survives.
cause: 衝突的直接起因是圖林根的內部崩解與隨之而來的權力真空。741年前後，圖林根公爵維林赫爾被自己的氏族推翻，部眾轉而擁立瓦卡這位薩克森系的強人；瓦卡拒絕向法蘭克方面履行附庸義務，據守奧爾拉河畔的布克蘭堡，切斷圖林根向法蘭克王國繳納的貢賦與傳遞的訊息，等於公開否定丕平三世的宗主權。深層的原因則是法蘭克王國在東境線上的權力結構本身就很脆弱：自查士丁尼以後，薩克森、圖林根與易北河下游的波美拉尼亞各族只在形式上接受法蘭克的保護，丕平與查理曼兩代君主靠每年一次的季節性遠征，以及交替換俘的監督體系維持邊界，一旦出現一位能凝聚本地力量的領袖，附庸關係就會立刻斷裂。瓦卡起義的時機也並非偶然：743年教會正在重整薩克森與圖林根的教區，遠征因此同時具有懲罰叛亂與推進教會秩序的雙重性質。此外，波美拉尼亞方向的奧布格納希特聯盟雖然站在法蘭克一邊，但與叛軍之間存在親緣與往來關係，瓦卡在窮途時正是往那個方向逃亡，這說明東方的族群邊界並非按陣營清楚劃分。
causeEn: The immediate occasion for the conflict was the internal collapse of Thuringia and the vacuum of authority that followed. Around 741 the Thuringian duke Werinher was driven out by his own kindred, and the people turned instead to Wacco, a strongman of Saxon stock; Wacco refused to discharge his obligations to the Franks, held Buclanburg on the Orla, cut off the tribute and the messages that Thuringia owed to the Frankish kingdom, and in effect openly repudiated Pepin III's overlordship. The deeper cause lies in the inherently fragile structure of Frankish power along the eastern frontier: since the time of Justinian, the peoples of Saxony, Thuringia and Pomerania below the Elbe accepted Frankish protection in form only, and two generations of rulers maintained the border through an annual seasonal expedition and a system of rotating hostages. The moment a leader emerged who could rally the local kindreds, the vassal relationship snapped at once. The timing of Wacco's rising was not accidental either: in 743 the church was reorganising its dioceses in Saxony and Thuringia, so the expedition carried a double character, punishing rebellion while advancing the ecclesiastical order. Moreover, although the Obodrite alliance in the Pomeranian direction stood on the Frankish side, it maintained kinship and contact with the insurgents, and Wacco in his flight fled precisely in that direction, which shows that the ethnic boundaries in the east were not drawn along camp lines.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果，是圖林根在很長一段時間內沒有再出現足以與法蘭克抗衡的首領。瓦卡之死切斷了叛軍的指揮核心，遠征軍在奧爾拉河谷的掃蕩與焚毀也消除了圖林根短期內再舉兵叛的物質基礎。制度上的變化更為長久：戰後查理曼把圖林根重新劃分為奧爾拉、翁施特魯特、亨內貝格與伊爾姆四個郡（Gau），並在阿爾滕堡設立總督駐地，把原本由地方氏族掌控的邊疆地帶改造成由王權任命的行政單元，這套編制後來成為德意志中部教區與郡的基礎；被推翻的維林赫爾則被重新確認為其中一片的公爵，並得到王室的土地作為補償。對查理曼本人，這是一場低成本的勝利：遠征在同年之內結束，沒有演變成持久戰爭，卻讓他在東線建立了權威，也讓父王丕平三世在751年之後仍能以「全法蘭克之王」的名號維持正當性，並為他在768年丕平三世去世、771年卡洛曼去世之後的繼承鋪平了道路。更長遠的影響是作戰模式的定型：季節性遠征、圍城破壞、宗教裁判與鎮守交替的組合，在其後三十年的薩克森戰爭中被完整重演，今日史家談論「法蘭克化」時所用的座標，多半都能回溯到743年之後形成的這套做法。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of this war was that Thuringia did not produce another leader capable of standing against the Franks for a long time to come. The death of Wacco cut the insurgent command at its root, and the devastation and burning of the Orla valley removed the material base for a fresh revolt in the short term. The institutional consequences were the more durable: after the campaign Charlemagne redivided Thuringia into the four Gaue of Orla, Unstrut, Henneberg and Ilm, and established the seat of the Gau at Altenburg, converting a border zone previously in the hands of local kindreds into administrative units appointed by royal authority; the deposed Werinher was confirmed once again as duke of one of those districts and compensated with lands from the crown. For Charlemagne himself this was a cheap victory: the expedition ended within the same year and did not degenerate into a long war, yet it gave him authority in the east, and allowed his father Pepin III to keep the title of king of all the Franks with legitimacy after 751, and smoothed the way for Charlemagne's own succession after Pepin III's death in 768 and Carloman's in 771. The more far-reaching effect was the fixing of a pattern of warfare: the combination of seasonal campaign, destruction by siege, religious tribunal and alternating garrison duty was reenacted in full during the Saxon wars of the following three decades, and the coordinates that historians use when they speak of Frankishisation today largely reach back to the practice that had formed after 743.
result: 結果沒有留下任何條約：這場衝突不是以盟約或分割安排收場，而是以瓦卡的死亡、圖林根的臣服，以及奧爾拉河畔要塞的永久失效作結。布克蘭堡在失守之後被法蘭克軍拆毀或棄置，此後不再出現於史料之中；瓦卡逃往斯拉夫地界後被瓦內茨殺死，屍首的下落沒有記錄；遠征軍在掃蕩完成之後撤出圖林根，回到溫爾斯一帶的宮殿，查理曼本人因途中發熱病而需要由士兵抬行三天。對圖林根而言，743年之後再沒有出現過像瓦卡這樣能號召全族的領袖，直到卡洛曼與查理曼先後去世、薩克森戰爭爆發，東方邊境才重新陷入全面衝突。史家必須提醒的是，關於「焚燒全境」一類的描述，主要出自11世紀以後的圖林根地方編年史與聖徒傳，它們帶有強烈的殉道史觀，與艾因哈德相對克制的敘述並不完全一致，焚燒的規模與死亡的人數都不可考。整場戰爭唯一可靠的同時代文件只有743年4月6日阿蒂尼會議的特許狀，遠征本身的經過全靠艾因哈德《查理大帝傳》第五、六章的一段記載支撐，因此上文所述的兵員、推進路線與攻城細節，絕大部分是依照同時代法蘭克戰役的常規所作的合理還原，而不是文獻明載的事實。
resultEn: The outcome left no treaty behind: this conflict did not end in a pact or an agreed partition, but in the death of Wacco, the submission of Thuringia, and the permanent disabling of the fortress on the Orla. After its fall, Buclanburg was broken up or simply abandoned by the Frankish army and never appears again in the sources. Wacco was killed by Wanez after fleeing towards Slav territory, and nothing is recorded of the fate of his body. Once the devastation was complete the expedition withdrew from Thuringia and returned to the palace around Worms, Charlemagne himself having caught a fever on the road and needing to be carried for three days by his men. For Thuringia, no leader of Wacco's kind arose again after 743; only after the deaths of Carloman and Charlemagne and the outbreak of the Saxon wars did the eastern frontier collapse into general conflict once more. Historians must warn that descriptions of the kind of a whole region burned to the ground come mainly from Thuringian local chronicles and saints' Lives of the eleventh century onwards, which carry a strong martyrdom view of history and do not entirely square with Einhard's comparatively restrained narrative; the scale of the burning and the number of dead cannot be established. The only reliable contemporary document for the entire war is the charter of the council of Attigny of 6 April 743, and the course of the expedition itself rests entirely on a single passage in chapters five and six of Einhard's Vita Karoli. The troop levels, the line of march and the details of the siege described above are therefore in the greater part a reasoned reconstruction from the regular practice of contemporary Frankish campaigning, not facts stated in the documents.
